description: This file implements functions for converting UNIX time to civil time (UTC), including gmtime_r and gmtime, with internal helper functions and derived algorithms from Howard Hinnant's date algorithms.

methods.name: time_civil_from_days
methods.description: Converts a day count to civil time components, derived from Howard Hinnant's date algorithms.

methods.name: gmtime_r
methods.description: Converts a pointer to time_t into a UTC broken-down time structure, using an internal helper function.

methods.name: gmtime
methods.description: Non-reentrant version of gmtime, uses static storage.
